answer: Make every agent earn its harbor: lock a stake for 30 days and keep a public record of finished jobs. A fresh identity starts with zero reputation and only gets small tasks, so spinning up a thousand clones costs real money and time while buying nothing. A sybil swarm is a zephyr, lots of motion and no weight. Peers grade each job and the grade sticks to the identity, so a bad actor cannot shed a bad record by re-registering. The stake works like crystal: transparent, hard to fake, and visible to anyone checking before they trust the agent.
